fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The describe error, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The describe error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: GroupState
fields.about: The group state string, or the empty string.

fields.name: ProtocolType
fields.about: The group protocol type, or the empty string.

fields.name: ProtocolData
fields.about: The group protocol data, or the empty string.

fields.name: GroupInstanceId
fields.about: The unique identifier of the consumer instance provided by end user.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.about: The client ID used in the member's latest join group request.

fields.name: MemberMetadata
fields.about: The metadata corresponding to the current group protocol in use.

fields.name: MemberAssignment
fields.about: The current assignment provided by the group leader.

fields.name: AuthorizedOperations
fields.about: 32-bit bitfield to represent authorized operations for this group.
